  if = {
    limit = { OR = {
        scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator = { var:skonester_acm_craft_quality_wealth = 500 }

    create_artifact = { name = artifact_table_name description = skonester_cheat_menu_artifact_generic_desc creator = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator type = cabinet template = unique_artifact_template visuals = table wealth = 250 quality = 250 decaying = no modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier generate_history = no save_scope_as = skonester_new_crafted_artifact }
    scope:skonester_new_crafted_artifact = {
      skonester_acm_finalize_crafted_artifact_effect = yes
    }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { OR = {
        scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator = { var:skonester_acm_craft_quality_wealth = 100 }
        AND = {
          NOT = { exists = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator }
          scope:root = { var:skonester_acm_craft_quality_wealth = 100 }
        }
      } }
    create_artifact = { name = artifact_table_name description = skonester_cheat_menu_artifact_generic_desc creator = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator type = cabinet template = unique_artifact_template visuals = table wealth = 100 quality = 100 decaying = no modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier generate_history = no save_scope_as = skonester_new_crafted_artifact }
    scope:skonester_new_crafted_artifact = {
      skonester_acm_finalize_crafted_artifact_effect = yes
    }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { OR = {
        scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator = { var:skonester_acm_craft_quality_wealth = 10 }
        AND = {
          NOT = { exists = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator }
          scope:root = { var:skonester_acm_craft_quality_wealth = 10 }
        }
      } }
    create_artifact = { name = artifact_table_name description = skonester_cheat_menu_artifact_generic_desc creator = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator type = cabinet template = unique_artifact_template visuals = table wealth = 10 quality = 10 decaying = no modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier generate_history = no save_scope_as = skonester_new_crafted_artifact }
    scope:skonester_new_crafted_artifact = {

  }
  else = {
    create_artifact = { name = artifact_table_name description = skonester_cheat_menu_artifact_generic_desc creator = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator type = cabinet template = unique_artifact_template visuals = table wealth = 80 quality = 80 decaying = no modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier generate_history = no save_scope_as = skonester_new_crafted_artifact }

    }

}
